target_customer: Designers and developers who download or share UI kits, mockups and design resources
problem: Design resources for apps and sites were scattered. UpLabs gathered curated and community uploaded resources in one marketplace.
business_model: Community marketplace for design resources (revenue model not stated by sources)

founders.name: Matt Delac
founders.background_notes: YC page lists Matt Delac, now CEO of SheCodes. CB Insights text names Matt Aussaguel as co-founder, possibly the same person under an earlier name; unverified.

exit.reason: A design blog says the site would close on 1 June 2024 because it struggled to keep pace with AI changes in design. Unconfirmed by the company.

technical_complexity.rationale: A content marketplace and community site with uploads, voting and downloads is standard web engineering.

defensibility.rationale: Community content and traffic gave mild network effects, but similar resource sites such as Dribbble and Creative Market were easy to substitute.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No acquisition found. The product lived on for years before the reported 2024 closure.

market_need_then: The company launched from YC W16 with a TechCrunch description of a community-powered marketplace for ready-to-ship UI resources. UpLabs started as MaterialUp in 2014 for Material Design resources, per its own About page.

branding.name_origin: The About page says MaterialUp (2014) was rebranded as Uplabs to build a broader umbrella brand beyond Material Design, and later shortened to Up.
branding.domain_note: Used uplabs.com. Acquisition details not found.

rebrands.why: to become an umbrella brand beyond Material Design (company About page); a January 2016 blog still used MaterialUp

branding.community_and_virality: Daily community uploads. Other design blogs wrote 'alternatives to UpLabs' and shutdown pieces, which shows brand recognition.

brand_strength.rationale: A recognized name in the design community with a Medium blog and later alternatives and shutdown coverage, but no evidence it was a growth driver.

pivots.to: UpLabs, broad design resources for iOS, Android, web and illustration
pivots.why: umbrella brand per the About page

outcome_analysis: UpLabs grew from MaterialUp into a design resources community and joined YC W16 with a tiny team and a reported 120K USD seed. It ran for years but never showed a venture scale outcome, and a design blog reports it closed in June 2024 as AI changed how designers work. The cause rests on one blog, so the failure factor is other (AI era disruption of free design resource hubs), with a small niche and unclear revenue also plausible but unsourced.
notes: The seed figure and Sparkland Capital rest on a single database (CB Insights, round dated 9 March 2016). The shutdown date and reason come from one blog snippet; the article page returned 404 when fetched. No competitor source dated near March 2016 was found; alternatives pages are undated, so the list is empty. YC and CB Insights differ on the second founder's surname. The company website field was empty in the directory.
